en: A black‑and‑white postcard view of a broad tree‑lined avenue bordered by ornate multi‑storey stone and brick buildings. The photo is taken from an elevated position, looking along the street and over a park‑like esplanade with bare trees, suggesting early spring or late autumn. Hills covered with forest rise in the background. Printed text at the bottom left identifies the scene as a view of Sundsvall's esplanade from the south.
